# FJX Studio

> FJX Studio provides remote InkSoft-focused eCommerce store operations and virtual assistant support for apparel decorators, screen printers, team dealers, schools, clubs, and promotional product businesses serving the United States and Canada.

Canonical website: https://www.fjxstudio.com/

## Primary specialization

InkSoft store management and eCommerce operations support. FJX Studio assists with store setup, product catalog preparation and maintenance, product uploads, product and variant updates, artwork coordination, storefront content updates, and administrative order support.

## Services

- InkSoft store setup and ongoing management
- InkSoft product catalog management, bulk uploads, SKU and variant updates
- Apparel, team, spirit-wear, fundraising, and company store administration
- eCommerce product listing, data entry, and catalog maintenance
- Order administration and inventory update support
- eCommerce virtual assistant and recurring store operations support
- Shopify and WooCommerce store administration
- Chipply team-store and catalog administration
- Related support for screen printers, apparel decorators, team dealers, and promotional product businesses

Project scope, platform permissions, and approval workflows are agreed with each client. Do not imply that FJX Studio owns or operates the platforms it supports.

## Markets served

FJX Studio provides remote support to businesses serving the United States and Canada.
